description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `splitList(text)` koja deli tekst po zarezima i vraća niz stavki. Svaka stavka se čisti od razmaka na krajevima, a prazne stavke se ne ubacuju.

Primeri:
- `splitList('a, b,c')` → `['a', 'b', 'c']`
- `splitList('  x  ')` → `['x']`
- `splitList('')` → `[]`
- `splitList('a,,b')` → `['a', 'b']`

Ograničenje: `text` je string, i može biti prazan.
description.en:
Write a function `splitList(text)` that splits the text by commas and returns an array of items. Each item is trimmed of spaces at both ends, and empty items are not included.

Examples:
- `splitList('a, b,c')` → `['a', 'b', 'c']`
- `splitList('  x  ')` → `['x']`
- `splitList('')` → `[]`
- `splitList('a,,b')` → `['a', 'b']`

Constraint: `text` is a string, and it can be empty.

label.en: a loop: split, trim, skip empty

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function splitList` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(text)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `splitList('a,b')`, unutar funkcije je `text` jednako `'a,b'`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 8.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function splitList` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(text)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `splitList('a,b')`, inside the function `text` equals `'a,b'`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 8 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Pravimo prazan niz u koji ćemo upisivati stavke.

- `const result = [];` pravi prazan niz; `[]` je prazan niz.
- `const` znači da se promenljiva `result` ne dodeljuje ponovo. Sadržaj niza se menja kad dodajemo stavke, a to je dozvoljeno.
text.en:
We create an empty array into which we will write the items.

- `const result = [];` creates an empty array; `[]` is an empty array.
- `const` means the variable `result` is not reassigned. The array's contents change as we add items, which is allowed.

text.sr:
Petlja `for...of` prolazi kroz delove teksta, jedan po jedan.

- `text.split(',')` seče tekst na mestima gde su zarezi i vraća niz delova: `'a,b'` postaje `['a', 'b']`.
- `for (const part of ...)` uzima jedan po jedan deo; u `part` je u svakom prolazu trenutni deo.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 6.

```
'a, ,b'.split(',')  → ['a', ' ', 'b']
```
text.en:
A `for...of` loop goes through the pieces of the text, one by one.

- `text.split(',')` cuts the text where the commas are and returns an array of pieces: `'a,b'` becomes `['a', 'b']`.
- `for (const part of ...)` takes the pieces one by one; `part` is the current piece on each pass.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 6.

```
'a, ,b'.split(',')  → ['a', ' ', 'b']
```

text.sr:
Čistimo razmake sa početka i kraja svakog dela.

- `part.trim()` uklanja razmake (i tabove, nove redove) sa oba kraja dela. Razmaci u sredini ostaju.
- `const item` pravi promenljivu za očišćen deo; `const` jer se ne dodeljuje ponovo.

```
' b '.trim()   → 'b'
'  '.trim()    → ''     (samo razmaci postaju prazan tekst)
'a b'.trim()    → 'a b'  (razmak u sredini ostaje)
```
text.en:
We trim the spaces from the start and the end of each piece.

- `part.trim()` removes spaces (and tabs, newlines) from both ends of the piece. Spaces in the middle stay.
- `const item` creates a variable for the trimmed piece; `const` because it is not reassigned.

```
' b '.trim()   → 'b'
'  '.trim()    → ''     (only spaces become an empty text)
'a b'.trim()    → 'a b'  (the space in the middle stays)
```

text.sr:
Stavku dodajemo samo ako nije prazna.

- `item !== ''` pita da li očišćen deo nije prazan tekst. `!==` je stroga nejednakost.
- `if (...) result.push(item);` nema vitičastih zagrada, pa u `if` spada samo `result.push(item)`.
- `push` dodaje stavku na kraj niza `result`.
- Prazni delovi se javljaju i kad je tekst prazan (`''.split(',')` je `['']`) i kad su dva zareza zaredom, pa je ova provera neophodna.

```
delovi: ['a', ' ', 'b']
'a'  → nije prazan  → push → ['a']
' '  → trim → ''   → prazan → preskače se
'b'  → nije prazan  → push → ['a', 'b']
```
text.en:
We add an item only if it is not empty.

- `item !== ''` asks whether the trimmed piece is not an empty text. `!==` is strict inequality.
- `if (...) result.push(item);` has no curly braces, so only `result.push(item)` belongs to the `if`.
- `push` adds the item to the end of the array `result`.
- Empty pieces also appear when the text is empty (`''.split(',')` is `['']`) and when two commas are in a row, so this check is necessary.

```
pieces: ['a', ' ', 'b']
'a'  → not empty → push → ['a']
' '  → trim → ''   → empty → skipped
'b'  → not empty → push → ['a', 'b']
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 3.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 3.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Vraćamo sve prikupljene stavke.

- Za prazan tekst `split` daje `['']`, taj jedini deo je prazan posle čišćenja i preskače se, pa je rezultat `[]`.
text.en:
We return all the items we collected.

- For an empty text `split` gives `['']`; that single piece is empty after trimming and is skipped, so the result is `[]`.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Dva koraka: prvo se tekst podeli, pa se svaki deo očisti i proveri. Prazne stavke se preskaču.
note.en: Two steps: first the text is split, then every piece is trimmed and checked. Empty items are skipped.
